content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The conventional digital commerce stack is built on platforms like Stripe, Gumroad, and PayPal, which can be restrictive and unreliable, particularly for creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan, where payment processing is often delayed or rejected, leaving creators without access to their earnings, but with COREMERCH's Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, free from the limitations of traditional platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up a NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to choose a sovereign digital commerce stack, which includes a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, a file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and a payment processing tool like NOWPayments, which offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee and supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With NOWPayments integrated into your sovereign digital commerce stack, you can set up a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, where customers can purchase digital products and receive instant access to their downloads, without the need for manual intervention or platform reliance, and with NOWPayments' automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, you can ensure that payments are secure and reliable, even in countries with restrictive payment processing policies.
With NOWPayments, you can receive crypto payments for your digital products, without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live with your NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, which can be done in as little as 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack, and once deployed, you can start processing transactions and receiving payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron and Solana, which offer fast and affordable transaction fees, under $0.10 per transaction, making them an attractive alternative to PayPal.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your NOWPayments digital store is up and running, you can scale your infrastructure to meet growing demand, using the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, and with NOWPayments' reliable payment processing, you can focus on growing your business, without worrying about payment processing delays or restrictions.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring secure and reliable payments, even in countries with restrictive payment processing policies.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up a NOWPayments digital store, follow these steps: Choose a sovereign digital commerce stack, which includes a hosting platform, backend logic tool, order storage solution, file delivery system, and payment processing tool; Deploy your stack in as little as 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack; Integrate NOWPayments into your stack for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification; Set up a seamless payment and delivery pipeline; Process transactions and receive payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron and Solana; Scale your infrastructure using the Complete Builder Kit; and focus on growing your business, without worrying about payment processing delays or restrictions.
